Name: Dismantle Craftables
Author: jahangmar
Description:
[size=4][b]What it does:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*]Press a configurable key (default 'R') to dismantle the selected item stack in your inventory.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][size=4][b]
Uninstall[/b][/size][size=4][b]:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Remove the folder of this mod.
[/list][size=4][b]
Configuration:[/b][/size]
You can change some values in the config.json file (start the game once with this mod for it to be generated):
[list]
[*]dismantle_key: find possible values [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings]here[/url]﻿. (default 'R')
[*]loss: value between 0% and 100%. Determines how many resources are lost during dismantling. (default 49%)
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Tested with Stardew Valley 1.4 on Linux and Windows.
[*]German translation available.
[/list]
[url=https://github.com/jahangmar/StardewValleyMods/tree/master/DismantleCraftables_Project/MonoDismantleCraftables]source code
[/url]
If you like this mod you might also like my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3771]Interaction Tweaks[/url].
